scientific_integrity: Infinite-parameter result proved by the embedded argument; finite exhaustive checks corroborate it. No independent mathematical audit or external certification has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: The exact spectrum applies to the two binary equal-length opposite-block words only, with deletion-minimality rather than shortest-only merging; it does not optimize or classify arbitrary input pairs. The binomial-square sequence and its arithmetic asymptotic were known before this interpretation. Earlier unindexed coverage may exist.
title: Complete length spectrum of minimal common supersequences for opposite binary blocks
